newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo says avoids truckers'strike.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo says avoids truckers'strike.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said its French cargo was getting through Tuesday to the airline's Frankfurt hub with only slight delays despite the continuing French truckers' strike.
Lufthansa spokesman Dietrich Seidl told Reuters that the airline's trucking companies were not taking part in the strike action now in its ninth day.
"There are slight delays at present because of the difficult situation, but overall it is going fairly well," he said.
"Our drivers know where the worst points are and how to get around them," he added.
French truckers have blocked the Franco-German border at Strasbourg but the Saarbruecken route was still clear, he added.

Lufthansa Cargo operates road feeder services from Paris, Bordeaux, Nantes and Lille to Frankfurt where air cargo is gathered for onward transport, Seidl said. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
